text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I experience it, 
this atmosphere always makes my heart 
race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No. Just running my own race... When I 
think of that, I feel strangely at ease.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The final jewel of the Classic Triple 
Crown, the Kikuka Sho. Today marks the end 
of a chapter for my goal.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I will run with all my might to the very 
end, without letting my guard down!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan's Trainer! How was it? How is 
Dia-chan doing?

It looks like we'll be able to head into 
the race without incident this time. And 
Satono Diamond hasn't mentioned the jinx 
even once today.

That seems like a good sign for Satono 
Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's Satono Diamond! She's looking all 
fired up and ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"According to his interview, he wasn't 
satisfied with his runs in either the 
Satsuki Sho or the Tokyo Yushun."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Then I definitely want to see what your 
best running looks like!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I think we're going to see 
Dia-chan's best run ever today!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Because I've never seen Dia-chan that 
focused before...!"
